summary: Match iOS contextual action-key accents without overriding configured key opacity.

changes.title: Correct Apple key accent scope
changes.detail: Manual Apple palette or wallpaper accent applies only to the actual contextual Go/Search/Send/Next/Done return key. Ordinary Return, Shift, Delete, 123, letters, punctuation, space, custom labels and other controls remain neutral. Remove the extended accent toggle.

changes.title: Preserve configured opacity
changes.detail: Copy the existing contextual key normal/pressed alpha when applying the palette, without changing shared toolbar, glass or other key colors. Verify every alpha value and contextual action allowlist in unit tests.

changes.title: Keep full-keyboard vault gesture and rounded keycaps
changes.detail: Footer-start one-finger gesture, encrypted vault, practice keyboard and optional rounded rectangle keycaps remain intact. Device verification pending.
